title: Load Shedding Stage 3 — Soweto
body: Eskom has implemented Stage 3 load shedding from 14:00 to 18:30 today. Affected blocks: 5, 6, 7, 8 in Soweto. Check your block schedule below.

title: SASSA Grant Payments — June 2026
body: SASSA June payments begin: Older persons (05 Jun), Disability (06 Jun), Children's grants (07 Jun). Visit your nearest SASSA office or SASSA card merchant.

title: Water Supply Interruption — Pimville Zone 2
body: Joburg Water reports a burst pipe on Mooki Street. Repairs underway. Water supply expected to resume by 18:00. Alternative water supply provided at Pimville Community Hall.

title: Road Closure — Chris Hani Road
body: Chris Hani Road between Old Potchefstroom and Klipspruit Valley Road closed due to a taxi accident. Use alternative routes via N12 or Soweto Highway.

title: Weather Warning — Thunderstorms Expected
body: SAWS has issued a yellow level 2 warning for severe thunderstorms in the Gauteng region, including Soweto. Expect heavy rain, strong winds, and possible hail from 15:00.
